preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The number of queries in each test case is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each integer X in a query is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The sum of the number of elements with an even number of 1's (E) and the number of elements with an odd number of 1's (O) equals the size of the set S.

postconditions.expression: all(count_ones(y) % 2 == 0 for y in S if y != X)
postconditions.description: For each y in S before the current query, where y is not equal to X, the number of 1's in the binary representation of y is even.

postconditions.expression: all(count_ones(y ^ X) % 2 == 1 for y in S if y != X)
postconditions.description: For each y in S before the current query, where y is not equal to X, the number of 1's in the binary representation of y XOR X is odd.
The integer X is not already in the set S.

invariants.description: The set S is maintained as a collection of unique elements.
